rationale: M59.A7 (#825) line round for the ruby lane, plus the three defects this round's independent oracle exposed. LINES: every expected line is the line where the edge's TARGET is written — a chain wrapped one call per line pins that the stamp is the CALLEE's node and not the receiver's (`strip` on 36, `upper` on 37, receiver `helper` on 35), and a WRAPPED superclass pins that `extends` rides the base type's node (29) and never the `superclass` node, which starts at `<` on 28. SEMANTICS, both found by measurement rather than reasoning: (1) a VARIABLE receiver names no class, so `@factory.new` on 39 is the member call `new` — it used to be emitted as `instantiates Widget` on that line, a class name no source line supports, and the F5 truth derivation mirrored the same fallback so the differential could not see it; (2) `self.new` on 41 IS an instantiation of the enclosing class, and says so (meta.resolvedTarget=enclosing-class) so the M59 oracle can classify the missing name rather than convict the correct line. MEASURED BEFORE/AFTER at 200 files through the M59 oracle: 22,844 relationships, 0 noLine, 23 INCONSISTENT (20 instantiates + 3 overrides naming a `Struct.new(...)` expression) BEFORE; 22,841 relationships, 0 noLine, 0 INCONSISTENT AFTER — the 23 decompose exactly: 19 claims became the marked uncheckable-by-token class, 1 became a truthful calls:new, 3 phantom edges are gone.

forbidRelationships.note: THE PRE-FIX PIN, AND IT WAS PINNING A DEFECT. This row was AUTHORED as the RUBY-D1 positive: `include Comparable` is mixin composition, not implements. MEASURED against the whole admitted population on 2026-10-21, that reading was WRONG for THIS SITE: line 43 is INSIDE `def assemble` — a plain instance method — so `self` is an INSTANCE, `include` is not Module#include at all, and the mixin never enters Widget's ancestor chain. The published edge `Widget mixes_in Comparable` claimed a composition of the class that does not happen. IT IS NOW A FORBID ROW, and the reason it moved is the MEASUREMENT (127 of 543 published rows were impostors), not a re-reading of the file. The pin's own subject — that `include` is composition and not `implements` — is kept in the `mixin-discriminator` fixture, where the site IS a class body.
